name: suvidha-root
description: SUVIDHA - Student Feedback & Grievance Management System (7th Sem B.Tech CSE Project)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'backend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test

author: SUVIDHA Team
